title: Treatise on the Sleeve Pinning Toss
summary: Teaches a thrower to pin cloth and sleeve to wood so an opponent's arm is held from striking.

title: Handbook of the Rolling Spin Series
summary: Chains several spin throws into one running sequence and shows how to guard the body between releases.

title: Canon of the Moving Thrower
summary: Trains a thrower to release accurately while stepping and circling so no opponent can settle on a target.

title: Primer of the Turned-Back Throw
summary: Covers throws made over the shoulder and from a retreat so a fleeing thrower still strikes the pursuer.

title: Treatise on Rope and Cord Cutting Throws
summary: Shows how to sever ropes and straps and tethers with a thrown edge at a distance.

title: The Bandolier Hand Reader
summary: Teaches fast draws from a chest bandolier and the order in which a wearer should spend its blades.

title: Handbook of the Close Fan of Blades
summary: Spreads three or four blades from one hand in a short fan that covers a foe's dodging routes.

title: Workbook of Thrown Guard Breaking
summary: Uses thrown blades to knock a raised shield or blade from line so the follow-up cut can land.
